tex_content.html:
Lemma
[normal coordinate along the radial geodesic]

↗ def:dc-ch3-expmap ↗ lem:dc-ch3-2-9-c1diffeo

1. ch3:4.1There is $\varepsilon >0$ and a local inverse $\exp _p^{-1}$ of $\exp _p$ on $B_\varepsilon (0)$ such that for every $v$ and every $t$ with $\| tv\| <\varepsilon $, $\exp _p^{-1}(\exp _p(tv))=tv$. Hence along the radial geodesic $t\mapsto \exp _p(tv)$ the normal coordinate $u(t)=\exp _p^{-1}(\gamma (t,p,v))$ is $tv$ itself, and $F(t)=|u(t)|_p^2=t^2|v|_p^2$.
Proof

\sketch

This is the left-inverse clause of the $C^1$ diffeomorphism subsection 1.2, instantiated at $w=tv$.

□
